source_role: first capture target for the Vanadium alternate-branch source-completeness gate
purpose: Turn the Vanadium alternate-branch blocker into a concrete source-acquisition target before any branch input table or verifier is created.

not_a_raw_patch.reason: This packet targets alternate-branch source completeness only. The raw McMillan row remains a failure diagnostic.

theta_D_or_proxy_context.branch_limitation: Not usable as Allen-Dynes omega_log or omega2.

capture_targets_in_order.target_kind: explicit Eliashberg or Allen-Dynes reproduction contract
capture_targets_in_order.why_first: The same open-fulltext family already supplies lambda and mu-star values, so it is the shortest route to determine whether those values belong to a reproducible branch convention.
required_capture_fields: kernel or spectral convention if stated
capture_targets_in_order.success_condition: A reviewer can state exactly which equation or reproduction target the Vanadium branch would check, without substituting Theta_D as omega_log.

capture_targets_in_order.source_title_or_doi: compatible phonon-spectrum or Allen-Dynes source family
capture_targets_in_order.why_second: An Allen-Dynes strict row needs phonon moments; the currently captured Theta=338+/-5 K is explicitly only Debye/proxy context.
capture_targets_in_order.success_condition: A source-complete Allen-Dynes row can be assembled without treating Debye temperature as omega_log.

capture_targets_in_order.source_title_or_doi: policy record local to this Vanadium branch package
capture_targets_in_order.why_third: Even if the equation or moments are captured, the existing non-mirrored acceptance only covers the Nb3Sn PhysRevB.27.1568 branch.
capture_targets_in_order.success_condition: The Vanadium branch can release strict evidence without borrowing the Nb3Sn-specific policy.

blocked_until: Vanadium-specific evidence policy is accepted for the captured source package.
The topic creates a separate branch input table and verifier artifact without changing the raw McMillan gate.
claim_boundary: This packet is an acquisition target only. It does not certify a Vanadium branch, does not create a PASS, and does not authorize row migration or raw-row patching.
